podcast.body: Flea developed the bassline for this song as part of a side project called Hate with members of Fishbone, intending it for Hate, but the band broke up. John Frusciante's guitar part was reportedly inspired by ghosts in The Mansion studio. Radio stations initially hesitated to play it due to a lack of traditional melody, but its power eventually became evident. "Lee came up with the bass line while working on a side project called Hate with a few members of the punk-funk band Fishbone."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: The 1991 video for "Give It Away" is noted for its great series of black and white images filmed in the desert. It is remembered as one of the truly great music videos from the "glory years" of the 1980s and 1990s. "There was the Red Hat Chili Peppers give it away in 1991, featuring a great series of black and white images in the desert."
